declared: 2026-11-09, before the frozen rustc 1.98.0 oracle of these exact bytes and before any RustGM run of them, in obj/parallel/census-batch20/fixtures/declared.txt (sha256 85b8ab985c40b39c156764dd068abb263b20930bef397765d80705fa917d413e). The shapes reduce census 22's crate record "no applicable trait method for this prefix" at core's `<*const VTable>::cmp(&self.vtable_ptr(), &other.vtable_ptr())` (library/core/src/ptr/metadata.rs:251), a call of a method of `const trait Ord: [const] Eq + [const] PartialOrd<Self> + PointeeSized` (cmp.rs:982) through the non-const `impl<T: PointeeSized> Ord for *const T`. Exploration probes with other bytes were run first: obj/parallel/census-batch20/probes/r1 to r8, each declared before its run, with the census 22 pin and rustc 1.98.0. Each outcome follows the rule observed in those rustc runs: method lookup ignores constness, so the method resolves through an ordinary impl or an ordinary `T: Cmp` premise, a `[const]` supertrait of its trait is required only when the call is in a const context, where an ordinary impl or premise does not satisfy it (E0277), and two applicable trait methods are ambiguous (E0034)
